reuse.why: Adds the #fixed rule inside the existing isLockedForMonthFill helper and reuses the shared extractTagsFromText tag parser.

duplication.why: The rule is written once; only the group-notes join has to be added to both existing category queries (getBudgetData and getMonthFillCategories), which already mirror each other.

placement.why: The exclusion lives in budget/month-fill.ts, the module that already owns which categories month-wide actions write.

scope.why: Only the shared rule, the two queries feeding it, and tests change.

maintainability.why: Every month-wide action picks up the new exclusion through the existing helper with no per-action edits.

one_place.where: isLockedForMonthFill in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/month-fill.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth directly and by getMonthFillCategories for the other actions
